value.rationale: This is a complete intrinsic geometric invariant of a natural infinite graphic-matroid family, including all maximizing-center dimensions. The \(p^{3/2}\) boundary separates coordinate- and degree-controlled Euclidean inspheres; the proof excludes exponentially many rank inequalities as nearer constraints. The high-dimensional center-locus transition is structurally nontrivial and not a mere numeric or renaming exercise.
